description: Test the next 20 minimum-difference unions in the shared QKV matrix
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,764 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 25 prior macro-attempts and 346 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0082/micro-0020 at 1,764 parameters and 99.01%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0081/micro-0007, a token-matrix union at 1,783 parameters that scored 98.97%. Hypothesis: the shared QKV matrix contains a broader band of near-duplicate scalars beyond the first 20 accepted unions, so continuing the recomputed ascending-difference ordering for one additional fixed band can reduce count while preserving qualification. This parameterization-preserving compression is more informative than switching immediately to feed-forward scalars because it measures whether the prior cap, rather than a QKV sensitivity boundary, stopped progress; the next current QKV union is the nearest untested candidate in that site. Each micro-trial adds one union and the official runner alone accepts or rolls back. Stop on the first scored discard or error, at the 20-micro-trial cap, or if no pair remains. Compute budget: at most 20 checkpoint migrations and official verifications or 30 wall-clock minutes.
summary: Completed the second declared band of 20 nearest shared-QKV scalar unions. All 20 qualified and were retained, moving the frontier from 1,764 parameters at 99.01% to 1,744 parameters at 99.01%; 20 accepts, 0 discards, 0 errors. Pairwise differences rose through 4.096e-5. Compute used checkpoint migration plus 20 official verifications, no fresh optimization, over 24m01s wall clock. Stop reason: fixed 20-micro-trial cap; no scored QKV boundary was reached.
